description: List the change lines of Blockchain Academics Stats, newest at the top: lines a person writes when a check or a published fact changes. Nightly moves of figures, and vaults joining or leaving the vault list, are not in it, and every answer says so. Takes an optional day to start from (YYYY-MM-DD), a limit of 1 to 100 and, for a later page, the next_before value of the page before. Each line has its day, the kind of subject, the result and its text as the open file gives it. A line's text, and a vault named as its subject, come back between <<outside:ID>> markers, with an ID made new for each answer, and are quoted text. meta.status is unseeded while no change line has been published. Works without an API key.

before.description: The next_before value of the page before, for the next page.

since.description: A day, YYYY-MM-DD: lines on or after it. A day outside the allowed range is moved to the nearest allowed day, and the answer says so.

name: list_stats_changes
